text: Which statement correctly describes the Neighbor-Joining (NJ) method?
choices: It assumes a strict molecular clock and produces an ultrametric, rooted tree
It is a Bayesian method that samples tree topologies via MCMC
It uses a Q-matrix correction, does not assume a molecular clock, and produces an unrooted tree
It guarantees recovery of the globally optimal maximum-likelihood tree
explanation: Neighbor-joining uses a Q-matrix that accounts for total branch length to iteratively join the pair with minimum corrected distance, does not assume a molecular clock, and outputs an unrooted tree in O(n³) time. It is not a Bayesian/MCMC method (that describes MrBayes or BEAST2), and as a fast distance-based heuristic it has no guarantee of finding the globally optimal maximum-likelihood tree.
